headline: South Korea Pledges Market Support Measures as KOSPI Drops 5%
summary: South Korea's finance ministry pledged emergency stock market stabilization measures after the KOSPI index dropped 5%. Authorities maintained positive economic growth projections for next year.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's benchmark stock index, heavily weighted toward technology and semiconductor manufacturers.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Government intervention assurances followed a severe single-day selloff in South Korean shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: South Korean stocks dropped sharply amid global tech sector selling before regulators promised market support.
